why: Abrupt just-under deposits unsupported by sales or inventory.

alert.rule: Many-to-one: cash deposits from out of area

why: Parents supporting a student, small amounts.

why: Transfers split under internal review threshold with stated intent.

alert.rule: Deposits near threshold - flea market vendor

state.alert: Case note, FIU analyst K. Abara, Meridian Trust Bank (fictional). Alert 2026-SAR-QA-5561, rule 'rapid cash in / wire out'. alert.narrative: Mobile detailer deposits cash a few times a month, $500-$2,500, more in spring. Two owners, both deposit. Consistent with 2 years of history.

why: Small seasonal business cash.

alert.narrative: Motel's cash from walk-in guests is deposited daily and usually a few hundred to a couple thousand. In the last month there were extra deposits in the $9,000s on several days, made by the owner's cousin at other branches. Occupancy reports show no increase.

why: Extra just-under deposits by a relative, no business basis.

alert.jurisdiction: US state-licensed cannabis business; CTR over $10,000; bank files marijuana-limited SARs per guidance

alert.rule: Deposits under threshold - youth sports league

alert.rule: Cash just under LCTR across branches and days

alert.narrative: Deposits $100-$400 from cleaning clients most weeks. Steady.
